dependency_notes: Requires org.jsoup:jsoup with the Safelist API. The method returns null for null input. The basic safelist preserves ordinary text and common formatting while filtering attributes and URL schemes. Relative URLs may be removed because no base URI is supplied. Render the result as an HTML body fragment. Compilation and runtime tests were not run.
retrieval_notes: Both VCKG searches succeeded and returned three exemplar chains each. There were no empty results. The raw HTML rendering chain illustrated the risk of passing untrusted markup to the browser. The HTML sanitizer and output sanitization chains supported filtering parsed elements and attributes before returning the fragment. The label escaping chain concerned interpolation into HTML attributes and JavaScript strings. The password reset and security-header chains supplied no direct implementation guidance. The chains informed the design and provide no evidence about FormatUtil or its callers.
